# ============================================================ # SERVER SCRIPT — Performance Settings # Script Type : API # API Method : blast_email_performance # ============================================================ docname = frappe.form_dict.get('docname') if not docname: frappe.throw("Document name not found.") # Flag ini men-skip semua validasi custom (termasuk pengecekan weightage) # yang ada di hooks.py atau controller Python custom app doc = frappe.get_doc("Performance Settings", docname) doc.flags.ignore_validate = True doc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True doc.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = True pengirim_email = "trialerp@globalmagicko.com" count = 0 failed = [] skipped_duplicate = [] if not doc.appraisees: frappe.throw("No employees (appraisees) found in this document.") base_url = frappe.utils.get_url() deadline = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.submission_deadline) if doc.submission_deadline else "-" # Debug: log nilai weightage dari setiap baris rating_criteria debug_weightage = [] for rc in doc.rating_criteria: debug_weightage.append( f"{rc.criteria_name}: weightage={rc.get('weightage')} | weightage_={rc.get('weightage_')}" ) for d in doc.appraisees: try: employee_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee", d.employee) recipient = ( employee_doc.get("user_id") or employee_doc.get("prefered_email") or employee_doc.get("company_email") or employee_doc.get("personal_email") ) if not recipient: failed.append( f"{d.employee_name} — no email found. " f"user_id='{employee_doc.get('user_id')}' | " f"prefered_email='{employee_doc.get('prefered_email')}' | " f"company_email='{employee_doc.get('company_email')}' | " f"personal_email='{employee_doc.get('personal_email')}'" ) continue # Cek duplikasi KRA and Goal Setup existing_kra = frappe.db.get_value( "KRA and Goal Setup", { "employee" : d.employee, "performance_settings": docname, }, "name" ) if existing_kra: kra_name = existing_kra skipped_duplicate.append(d.employee_name) else: kra_doc = frappe.new_doc("KRA and Goal Setup") kra_doc.employee = employee_doc.name kra_doc.employee_name = employee_doc.employee_name kra_doc.company = employee_doc.company kra_doc.performance_settings = docname kra_doc.cycle_year = doc.cycle_year kra_doc.status = "Draft" if employee_doc.reports_to: kra_doc.reports_to = employee_doc.reports_to kra_doc.line_manager_name = frappe.db.get_value( "Employee", employee_doc.reports_to, "employee_name" ) kra_doc.flags.ignore_validate = True kra_doc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True kra_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() kra_name = kra_doc.name kra_link = f"{base_url}/app/kra-and-goal-setup/{kra_name}" subject = f"[ACTION REQUIRED] Performance Evaluation Cycle {doc.cycle_year} is Now Open" message = f"""

Performance Cycle {doc.cycle_year}

{employee_doc.company}

Dear {employee_doc.employee_name},

The performance evaluation cycle for {doc.cycle_year} has officially begun. Please complete your KRA & Goal Setup as soon as possible.

Submission Deadline

{deadline}

⚠️ Important: Complete your KRA & Goal Setup first and get Manager approval before proceeding to Performance Evaluation.

📋   Open My KRA & Goal Setup

Or copy this link:
{kra_link}

If you encounter any issues, contact HR or IT.
This is an automated message. Please do not reply.

""" frappe.sendmail( sender = pengirim_email, recipients = [recipient], subject = subject, content = message, now = True ) count += 1 except Exception as e: failed.append(f"{d.employee_name}: {str(e)}") # Summary summary_parts = [f"Successfully sent emails to {count} employees."] if skipped_duplicate: summary_parts.append(f"Skipped (KRA already existed): {', '.join(skipped_duplicate)}") if failed: summary_parts.append(f"Failed / No Email Found:
" + "
".join(failed)) # Debug weightage — hapus baris ini setelah masalah selesai if debug_weightage: summary_parts.append("Debug Weightage:
" + "
".join(debug_weightage)) frappe.msgprint("

".join(summary_parts)) frappe.response['message'] = summary_parts[0]

def get_permission_query_conditions(user):
    if not user:
        user = frappe.session.user

    # User yang boleh akses Performance Settings — tambah/kurangi sesuai kebutuhan
    allowed_users = [
        "florence@globalmagicko.com",
        "widya@globalmagicko.com",
        "agung@realmagicko.com"
        "nattawat@generalmagickindustries.com"
        # tambah user lain di sini
    ]

    if user in allowed_users or "System Manager" in frappe.get_roles(user):
        return ""

    # User lain tidak bisa lihat sama sekali
    return "1=0"
